gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Prologue
gospel_of_thomas.title: Prologue
gospel_of_thomas.t: These are the hidden sayings that the living Jesus spoke and Didymos Judas Thomas wrote down.

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 1: True Meaning
gospel_of_thomas.title: True Meaning
gospel_of_thomas.t: And he said, "Whoever discovers the meaning of these sayings won't taste death."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 2: Seek and Find
gospel_of_thomas.title: Seek and Find
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever seeks shouldn't stop until they find. When they find, they'll be disturbed. When they're disturbed, they'll be […] amazed, and reign over the All."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 3: Seeking Within
gospel_of_thomas.title: Seeking Within
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "If your leaders tell you, 'Look, the kingdom is in heaven,' then the birds of heaven will precede you. If they tell you, 'It's in the sea,' then the fish will precede you. Rather, the kingdom is within you and outside of you.

"When you know yourselves, then you'll be known, and you'll realize that you're the children of the living Father. But if you don't know yourselves, then you live in poverty, and you are the poverty."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 4: First and Last
gospel_of_thomas.title: First and Last
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The older person won't hesitate to ask a little seven-day-old child about the place of life, and they'll live, because many who are first will be last, and they'll become one."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 5: Hidden and Revealed
gospel_of_thomas.title: Hidden and Revealed
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Know what's in front of your face, and what's hidden from you will be revealed to you, because there's nothing hidden that won't be revealed."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 6: Public Ritual
gospel_of_thomas.title: Public Ritual
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said to him, "Do you want us to fast? And how should we pray? Should we make donations? And what food should we avoid?"

Jesus said, "Don't lie, and don't do what you hate, because everything is revealed in the sight of heaven; for there's nothing hidden that won't be revealed, and nothing covered up that will stay secret."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 7: The Lion and the Human
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Lion and the Human
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed is the lion that's eaten by a human and then becomes human, but how awful for the human who's eaten by a lion, and the lion becomes human."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 8: The Parable of the Fish
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Fish
gospel_of_thomas.t: He said, "The human being is like a wise fisher who cast a net into the sea and drew it up from the sea full of little fish. Among them the wise fisher found a fine large fish and cast all the little fish back down into the sea, easily choosing the large fish. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 9: The Parable of the Sower
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Sower
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Look, a sower went out, took a handful of seeds, and scattered them. Some fell on the roadside; the birds came and gathered them. Others fell on the rock; they didn't take root in the soil and ears of grain didn't rise toward heaven. Yet others fell on thorns; they choked the seeds and worms ate them. Finally, others fell on good soil; it produced fruit up toward heaven, some sixty times as much and some a hundred and twenty."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 10: Jesus and Fire (1)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Jesus and Fire (1)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "I've cast fire on the world, and look, I'm watching over it until it blazes."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 11: Those Who Are Living Won't Die (1)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Those Who Are Living Won't Die (1)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "This heaven will disappear, and the one above it will disappear too. Those who are dead aren't alive, and those who are living won't die. In the days when you ate what was dead, you made it alive. When you're in the light, what will you do? On the day when you were one, you became divided. But when you become divided, what will you do?"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 12: James the Just
gospel_of_thomas.title: James the Just
gospel_of_thomas.t:
The disciples said to Jesus, "We know you're going to leave us. Who will lead us then?"

Jesus said to them, "Wherever you are, you'll go to James the Just, for whom heaven and earth came into being."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 13: Thomas' Confession
gospel_of_thomas.title: Thomas' Confession
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said to his disciples, "If you were to compare me to someone, who would you say I'm like?"

Simon Peter said to him, "You're like a just angel."

Matthew said to him, "You're like a wise philosopher."

Thomas said to him, "Teacher, I'm completely unable to say whom you're like."

Jesus said, "I'm not your teacher. Because you've drunk, you've become intoxicated by the bubbling spring I've measured out."

He took him aside and told him three things. When Thomas returned to his companions, they asked, "What did Jesus say to you?"

Thomas said to them, "If I tell you one of the things he said to me, you'll pick up stones and cast them at me, and fire will come out of the stones and burn you up."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 14: Public Ministry
gospel_of_thomas.title: Public Ministry
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said to them, "If you fast, you'll bring guilt upon yourselves; and if you pray, you'll be condemned; and if you make donations, you'll harm your spirits.

"If they welcome you when you enter any land and go around in the countryside, heal those who are sick among them and eat whatever they give you, because it's not what goes into your mouth that will defile you. What comes out of your mouth is what will defile you."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 15: Worship
gospel_of_thomas.title: Worship
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "When you see the one who wasn't born of a woman, fall down on your face and worship that person. That's your Father."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 16: Not Peace, but War
gospel_of_thomas.title: Not Peace, but War
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Maybe people think that I've come to cast peace on the world, and they don't know that I've come to cast divisions on the earth: fire, sword, and war. Where there are five in a house, there'll be three against two and two against three, father against and son and son against father. They'll stand up and be one."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 17: Divine Gift
gospel_of_thomas.title: Divine Gift
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "I'll give you what no eye has ever seen, no ear has ever heard, no hand has ever touched, and no human mind has ever thought."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 18: Beginning and End
gospel_of_thomas.title: Beginning and End
gospel_of_thomas.t:
The disciples said to Jesus, "Tell us about our end. How will it come?"

Jesus said, "Have you discovered the beginning so that you can look for the end? Because the end will be where the beginning is. Blessed is the one who will stand up in the beginning. They'll know the end, and won't taste death."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 19: Five Trees in Paradise
gospel_of_thomas.title: Five Trees in Paradise
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed is the one who came into being before coming into being. If you become my disciples and listen to my message, these stones will become your servants; because there are five trees in paradise which don't change in summer or winter, and their leaves don't fall. Whoever knows them won't taste death."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 20: The Parable of the Mustard Seed
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Mustard Seed
gospel_of_thomas.t:
The disciples asked Jesus, "Tell us, what can the kingdom of heaven be compared to?"

He said to them, "It can be compared to a mustard seed. Though it's the smallest of all the seeds, when it falls on tilled soil it makes a plant so large that it shelters the birds of heaven."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 21: The Parables of the Field, the Bandits, and the Reaper
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parables of the Field, the Bandits, and the Reaper
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Mary said to Jesus, "Whom are your disciples like?"

He said, "They're like little children living in a field which isn't theirs. When the owners of the field come, they'll say, 'Give our field back to us.' They'll strip naked in front of them to let them have it and give them their field.

"So I say that if the owner of the house realizes the bandit is coming, they'll watch out beforehand and won't let the bandit break into the house of their domain and steal their possessions. You, then, watch out for the world! Prepare to defend yourself so that the bandits don't attack you, because what you're expecting will come. May there be a wise person among you!

"When the fruit ripened, the reaper came quickly, sickle in hand, and harvested it. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 22: Making the Two into One
gospel_of_thomas.title: Making the Two into One
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus saw some little children nursing. He said to his disciples, "These nursing children can be compared to those who enter the kingdom."

They said to him, "Then we'll enter the kingdom as little children?"

Jesus said to them, "When you make the two into one, and make the inner like the outer and the outer like the inner, and the upper like the lower, and so make the male and the female a single one so that the male won't be male nor the female female; when you make eyes in the place of an eye, a hand in the place of a hand, a foot in the place of a foot, and an image in the place of an image; then you'll enter [the kingdom]."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 23: Those Who are Chosen (1)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Those Who are Chosen (1)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "I'll choose you, one out of a thousand and two out of ten thousand, and they'll stand as a single one."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 24: Light
gospel_of_thomas.title: Light
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said, "Show us the place where you are, because we need to look for it."

He said to them, "Anyone who has ears to hear should hear! Light exists within a person of light, and they light up the whole world. If they don't shine, there's darkness."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 25: Love and Protect
gospel_of_thomas.title: Love and Protect
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Love your brother as your own soul. Protect them like the pupil of your eye."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 26: Speck and Beam
gospel_of_thomas.title: Speck and Beam
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "You see the speck that's in your brother's eye, but you don't see the beam in your own eye. When you get the beam out of your own eye, then you'll be able to see clearly to get the speck out of your brother's eye."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 27: Fasting and Sabbath
gospel_of_thomas.title: Fasting and Sabbath
gospel_of_thomas.t: "If you don't fast from the world, you won't find the kingdom. If you don't make the Sabbath into a Sabbath, you won't see the Father."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 28: The World is Drunk
gospel_of_thomas.title: The World is Drunk
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "I stood in the middle of the world and appeared to them in the flesh. I found them all drunk; I didn't find any of them thirsty. My soul ached for the children of humanity, because they were blind in their hearts and couldn't see. They came into the world empty and plan on leaving the world empty. Meanwhile, they're drunk. When they shake off their wine, then they'll change."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 29: Spirit and Body
gospel_of_thomas.title: Spirit and Body
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "If the flesh came into existence because of spirit, that's amazing. If spirit came into existence because of the body, that's really amazing! But I'm amazed at how [such] great wealth has been placed in this poverty."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 30: Divine Presence
gospel_of_thomas.title: Divine Presence
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Where there are three deities, they're divine. Where there are two or one, I'm with them."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 31: Prophet and Doctor
gospel_of_thomas.title: Prophet and Doctor
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "No prophet is welcome in their own village. No doctor heals those who know them."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 32: The Parable of the Fortified City
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Fortified City
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "A city built and fortified on a high mountain can't fall, nor can it be hidden."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 33: The Parable of the Lamp
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Lamp
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "What you hear with one ear, listen to with both, then proclaim from your rooftops. No one lights a lamp and puts it under a basket or in a hidden place. Rather, they put it on the stand so that everyone who comes and goes can see its light."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 34: The Parable of Those Who Can't See
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of Those Who Can't See
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "If someone who's blind leads someone else who's blind, both of them fall into a pit."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 35: The Parable of Binding the Strong
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of Binding the Strong
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "No one can break into the house of the strong and take it by force without tying the hands of the strong. Then they can loot the house."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 36: Anxiety
gospel_of_thomas.title: Anxiety
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Don't be anxious from morning to evening or from evening to morning about what you'll wear."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 37: Seeing Jesus
gospel_of_thomas.title: Seeing Jesus
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said, "When will you appear to us? When will we see you?"

Jesus said, "When you strip naked without being ashamed, and throw your clothes on the ground and stomp on them as little children would, then [you'll] see the Son of the Living One and won't be afraid."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 38: Finding Jesus
gospel_of_thomas.title: Finding Jesus
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Often you've wanted to hear this message that I'm telling you, and you don't have anyone else from whom to hear it. There will be days when you'll look for me, but you won't be able to find me."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 39: The Keys of Knowledge
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Keys of Knowledge
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The Pharisees and the scholars have taken the keys of knowledge and hidden them. They haven't entered, and haven't let others enter who wanted to. So be wise as serpents and innocent as doves."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 40: A Grapevine
gospel_of_thomas.title: A Grapevine
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "A grapevine has been planted outside of the Father. Since it's malnourished, it'll be pulled up by its root and destroyed."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 41: More and Less
gospel_of_thomas.title: More and Less
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever has something in hand will be given more, but whoever doesn't have anything will lose even what little they do have."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 42: Passing By
gospel_of_thomas.title: Passing By
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Become passersby."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 43: The Tree and the Fruit
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Tree and the Fruit
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said to him, "Who are you to say these things to us?"

"You don't realize who I am from what I say to you, but you've become like those Judeans who either love the tree but hate its fruit, or love the fruit but hate the tree."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 44: Blasphemy
gospel_of_thomas.title: Blasphemy
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever blasphemes the Father will be forgiven, and whoever blasphemes the Son will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, neither on earth nor in heaven."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 45: Good and Evil
gospel_of_thomas.title: Good and Evil
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Grapes aren't harvested from thorns, nor are figs gathered from thistles, because they don't produce fruit. [A person who's good] brings good things out of their treasure, and a person who's [evil] brings evil things out of their evil treasure. They say evil things because their heart is full of evil."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 46: Greater than John the Baptizer
gospel_of_thomas.title: Greater than John the Baptizer
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "From Adam to John the Baptizer, no one's been born who's so much greater than John the Baptizer that they shouldn't avert their eyes. But I say that whoever among you will become a little child will know the kingdom and become greater than John."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 47: The Parables of Divided Loyalties,
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parables of Divided Loyalties,
gospel_of_thomas.t:
New Wine in Old Wineskins, and New Patch on Old Cloth

Jesus said, "It's not possible for anyone to mount two horses or stretch two bows, and it's not possible for a servant to follow two leaders, because they'll respect one and despise the other.

"No one drinks old wine and immediately wants to drink new wine. And new wine isn't put in old wineskins, because they'd burst. Nor is old wine put in new wineskins, because it'd spoil.

"A new patch of cloth isn't sewn onto an old coat, because it'd tear apart."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 48: Unity (1)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Unity (1)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "If two make peace with each other in a single house, they'll say to the mountain, 'Go away,' and it will."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 49: Those Who Are Chosen (2)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Those Who Are Chosen (2)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed are those who are one – those who are chosen, because you'll find the kingdom. You've come from there and will return there."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 50: Our Origin and Identity
gospel_of_thomas.title: Our Origin and Identity
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "If they ask you, 'Where do you come from?' tell them, 'We've come from the light, the place where light came into being by itself, [established] itself, and appeared in their image.'

"If they ask you, 'Is it you?' then say, 'We are its children, and we're chosen by our living Father.'

"If they ask you, 'What's the sign of your Father in you?' then say, 'It's movement and rest.'"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 51: The New World
gospel_of_thomas.title: The New World
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said to him, "When will the dead have rest, and when will the new world come?"

He said to them, "What you're looking for has already come, but you don't know it."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 52: Twenty-Four Prophets
gospel_of_thomas.title: Twenty-Four Prophets
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said to him, "Twenty-four prophets have spoken in Israel, and they all spoke of you."

He said to them, "You've ignored the Living One right in front of you, and you've talked about those who are dead."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 53: True Circumcision
gospel_of_thomas.title: True Circumcision
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said to him, "Is circumcision useful, or not?"

He said to them, "If it were useful, parents would have children who are born circumcised. But the true circumcision in spirit has become profitable in every way."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 54: Those Who Are Poor
gospel_of_thomas.title: Those Who Are Poor
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed are those who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of heaven."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 55: Discipleship (1)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Discipleship (1)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever doesn't hate their father and mother can't become my disciple, and whoever doesn't hate their brothers and sisters and take up their cross like I do isn't worthy of me."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 56: The World is a Corpse
gospel_of_thomas.title: The World is a Corpse
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever has known the world has found a corpse. Whoever has found a corpse, of them the world isn't worthy."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 57: The Parable of the Weeds
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Weeds
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "My Fathers' kingdom can be compared to someone who had [good] seed. Their enemy came by night and sowed weeds among the good seed. The person didn't let anyone pull out the weeds, 'so that you don't pull out the wheat along with the weeds,' they said to them. 'On the day of the harvest, the weeds will be obvious. Then they'll be pulled out and burned.'"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 58: Finding Life
gospel_of_thomas.title: Finding Life
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed is the person who's gone to a lot of trouble. They've found life."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 59: The Living One
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Living One
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Look for the Living One while you're still alive. If you die and then try to look for him, you won't be able to."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 60: Don't Become a Corpse
gospel_of_thomas.title: Don't Become a Corpse
gospel_of_thomas.t:
They saw a Samaritan carrying a lamb to Judea. He said to his disciples, "What do you think he's going to do with that lamb?"

They said to him, "He's going to kill it and eat it."

He said to them, "While it's living, he won't eat it, but only after he kills it and it becomes a corpse."

They said, "He can't do it any other way."

He said to them, "You, too, look for a resting place, so that you won't become a corpse and be eaten."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 61: Jesus and Salome
gospel_of_thomas.title: Jesus and Salome
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "Two will rest on a couch. One will die, the other will live."

Salome said, "Who are you, Sir, to climb onto my couch and eat off my table as if you're from someone?"

Jesus said to her, "I'm the one who exists in equality. Some of what belongs to my Father was given to me."

"I'm your disciple."

"So I'm telling you, if someone is /equal\, they'll be full of light; but if they're divided, they'll be full of darkness."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 62: Mysteries
gospel_of_thomas.title: Mysteries
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "I tell my mysteries to [those who are worthy of my] mysteries. Don't let your left hand know what your right hand is doing."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 63: The Parable of the Rich Fool
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Rich Fool
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "There was a rich man who had much money. He said, 'I'll use my money to sow, reap, plant, and fill my barns with fruit, so that I won't need anything.' That's what he was thinking to himself, but he died that very night. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 64: The Parable of the Dinner Party
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Dinner Party
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "Someone was planning on having guests. When dinner was ready, they sent their servant to call the visitors.

"The servant went to the first and said, 'My master invites you.'

"They said, 'Some merchants owe me money. They're coming tonight. I need to go and give them instructions. Excuse me from the dinner.'

"The servant went to another one and said, 'My master invites you.'

"They said, "I've just bought a house and am needed for the day. I won't have time.'

"The servant went to another one and said, 'My master invites you.'

"They said, 'My friend is getting married and I'm going to make dinner. I can't come. Excuse me from the dinner.'

"The servant went to another one and said, 'My master invites you.'

"They said, "I've just bought a farm and am going to collect the rent. I can't come. Excuse me.'

"The servant went back and told the master, 'The ones you've invited to the dinner have excused themselves.'

"The master said to their servant, 'Go out to the roads and bring whomever you find so that they can have dinner.'

"Buyers and merchants won't [enter] the places of my Father."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 65: The Parable of the Sharecroppers
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Sharecroppers
gospel_of_thomas.t:
He said, "A [creditor] owned a vineyard. He leased it out to some sharecroppers to work it so he could collect its fruit.

"He sent his servant so that the sharecroppers could give him the fruit of the vineyard. They seized his servant, beat him, and nearly killed him.

"The servant went back and told his master. His master said, 'Maybe he just didn't know them.' He sent another servant, but the tenants beat that one too.

"Then the master sent his son, thinking, 'Maybe they'll show some respect to my son.'

"Because they knew that he was the heir of the vineyard, the sharecroppers seized and killed him. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 66: The Rejected Cornerstone
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Rejected Cornerstone
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Show me the stone the builders rejected; that's the cornerstone."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 67: Knowing Isn't Everything
gospel_of_thomas.title: Knowing Isn't Everything
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever knows everything, but is personally lacking, lacks everything."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 68: Persecution
gospel_of_thomas.title: Persecution
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed are you when you're hated and persecuted, and no place will be found where you've been persecuted."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 69: Those Who Are Persecuted
gospel_of_thomas.title: Those Who Are Persecuted
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed are those who've been persecuted in their own hearts. They've truly known the Father. Blessed are those who are hungry, so that their stomachs may be filled."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 70: Salvation is Within
gospel_of_thomas.title: Salvation is Within
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "If you give birth to what's within you, what you have within you will save you. If you don't have that within [you], what you don't have within you [will] kill you."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 71: Destroying the Temple
gospel_of_thomas.title: Destroying the Temple
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "I'll destroy [this] house, and no one will be able to build it […]"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 72: Not a Divider
gospel_of_thomas.title: Not a Divider
gospel_of_thomas.t:
[Someone said to him], "Tell my brothers to divide our inheritance with me."

He said to him, "Who made me a divider?"

He turned to his disciples and said to them, "Am I really a divider?"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 73: Workers for the Harvest
gospel_of_thomas.title: Workers for the Harvest
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The harvest really is plentiful, but the workers are few. So pray that the Lord will send workers to the harvest."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 74: The Empty Well
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Empty Well
gospel_of_thomas.t: He said, "Lord, many are gathered around the well, but there's nothing to drink."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 75: The Bridal Chamber
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Bridal Chamber
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Many are waiting at the door, but those who are one will enter the bridal chamber."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 76: The Parable of the Pearl
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Pearl
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "The Father's kingdom can be compared to a merchant with merchandise who found a pearl. The merchant was wise; they sold their merchandise and bought that single pearl for themselves.

"You, too, look for the treasure that doesn't perish but endures, where no moths come to eat and no worms destroy."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 77: Jesus is the All
gospel_of_thomas.title: Jesus is the All
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "I'm the light that's over all. I am the All. The All has come from me and unfolds toward me.

"Split a log; I'm there. Lift the stone, and you'll find me there."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 78: Into the Desert
gospel_of_thomas.title: Into the Desert
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed shaken by the wind? A [person] wearing fancy clothes, [like your] rulers and powerful people? They (wear) fancy [clothes], but can't know the truth."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 79: Listening to the Message
gospel_of_thomas.title: Listening to the Message
gospel_of_thomas.t:
A woman in the crowd said to him, "Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts that nourished you."

He said to [her], "Blessed are those who have listened to the message of the Father and kept it, because there will be days when you'll say, 'Blessed is the womb that didn't conceive and the breasts that haven't given milk.'"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 80: The World is a Body
gospel_of_thomas.title: The World is a Body
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever has known the world has found the body; but whoever has found the body, of them the world isn't worthy."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 81: Riches and Renunciation (1)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Riches and Renunciation (1)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever has become rich should become a ruler, and whoever has power should renounce it."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 82: Jesus and Fire (2)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Jesus and Fire (2)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever is near me is near the fire, and whoever is far from me is far from the kingdom."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 83: Light and Images
gospel_of_thomas.title: Light and Images
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Images are revealed to people, but the light within them is hidden in the image of the Father's light. He'll be revealed, but his image will be hidden by his light."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 84: Our Previous Images
gospel_of_thomas.title: Our Previous Images
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "When you see your likeness, you rejoice. But when you see your images that came into being before you did – which don't die, and aren't revealed – how much you'll have to bear!"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 85: Adam Wasn't Worthy
gospel_of_thomas.title: Adam Wasn't Worthy
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Adam came into being from a great power and great wealth, but he didn't become worthy of you. If he had been worthy, [he wouldn't have tasted] death."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 86: Foxes and Birds
gospel_of_thomas.title: Foxes and Birds
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "[The foxes have dens] and the birds have nests, but the Son of Humanity has nowhere to lay his head and rest."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 87: Body and Soul
gospel_of_thomas.title: Body and Soul
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "How miserable is the body that depends on a body, and how miserable is the soul that depends on both."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 88: Angels and Prophets
gospel_of_thomas.title: Angels and Prophets
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The angels and the prophets will come to you and give you what belongs to you. You'll give them what you have and ask yourselves, 'When will they come and take what is theirs?'"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 89: Inside and Outside
gospel_of_thomas.title: Inside and Outside
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Why do you wash the outside of the cup? Don't you know that whoever created the inside created the outside too?"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 90: Jesus' Yoke is Easy
gospel_of_thomas.title: Jesus' Yoke is Easy
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Come to me, because my yoke is easy and my requirements are light. You'll be refreshed."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 91: Reading the Signs
gospel_of_thomas.title: Reading the Signs
gospel_of_thomas.t:
They said to him, "Tell us who you are so that we may trust you."

He said to them, "You read the face of the sky and the earth, but you don't know the one right in front of you, and you don't know how to read the present moment."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 92: Look and Find
gospel_of_thomas.title: Look and Find
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Look and you'll find. I didn't answer your questions before. Now I want to give you answers, but you aren't looking for them."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 93: Don't Throw Pearls to Pigs
gospel_of_thomas.title: Don't Throw Pearls to Pigs
gospel_of_thomas.t: "Don't give what's holy to the dogs, or else it might be thrown on the manure pile. Don't throw pearls to the pigs, or else they might […]"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 94: Knock and It Will Be Opened
gospel_of_thomas.title: Knock and It Will Be Opened
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus [said], "Whoever looks will find, [and whoever knocks], it will be opened for them."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 95: Giving Money
gospel_of_thomas.title: Giving Money
gospel_of_thomas.t: [Jesus said], "If you have money, don't lend it at interest. Instead, give [it to] someone from whom you won't get it back."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 96: The Parable of the Yeast
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Yeast
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus [said], "The Father's kingdom can be compared to a woman who took a little yeast and [hid] it in flour. She made it into large loaves of bread. Anyone who has ears to hear should hear!"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 97: The Parable of the Jar of Flour
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Jar of Flour
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The Father's kingdom can be compared to a woman carrying a jar of flour. While she was walking down [a] long road, the jar's handle broke and the flour spilled out behind her on the road. She didn't know it, and didn't realize there was a problem until she got home, put down the jar, and found it empty."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 98: The Parable of the Assassin
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Assassin
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The Father's kingdom can be compared to a man who wanted to kill someone powerful. He drew his sword in his house and drove it into the wall to figure out whether his hand was strong enough. Then he killed the powerful one."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 99: Jesus' True Family
gospel_of_thomas.title: Jesus' True Family
gospel_of_thomas.t:
The disciples said to him, "Your brothers and mother are standing outside."

He said to them, "The people here who do the will of my Father are my brothers and mother; they're the ones who will enter my Father's kingdom."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 100: Give to Caesar What Belongs to Caesar
gospel_of_thomas.title: Give to Caesar What Belongs to Caesar
gospel_of_thomas.t:
They showed Jesus a gold coin and said to him, "Those who belong to Caesar demand tribute from us."

He said to them, "Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, give to God what belongs to God, and give to me what belongs to me."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 101: Discipleship (2)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Discipleship (2)
gospel_of_thomas.t: "Whoever doesn't hate their [father] and mother as I do can't become my [disciple], and whoever [doesn't] love their [father] and mother as I do can't become my [disciple]. For my mother […], but [my] true [Mother] gave me Life."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 102: The Dog in the Feeding Trough
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Dog in the Feeding Trough
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "How awful for the Pharisees who are like a dog sleeping in a feeding trough for cattle, because the dog doesn't eat, and [doesn't let] the cattle eat either."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 103: The Parable of the Bandits
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Bandits
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Blessed is the one who knows where the bandits are going to enter. [They can] get up to assemble their defenses and be prepared to defend themselves before they arrive."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 104: Prayer and Fasting
gospel_of_thomas.title: Prayer and Fasting
gospel_of_thomas.t:
They said to [Jesus], "Come, let's pray and fast today."

Jesus said, "What have I done wrong? Have I failed?

"Rather, when the groom leaves the bridal chamber, then people should fast and pray."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 105: Knowing Father and Mother
gospel_of_thomas.title: Knowing Father and Mother
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever knows their father and mother will be called a bastard."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 106: Unity (2)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Unity (2)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "When you make the two into one, you'll become Children of Humanity, and if you say 'Mountain, go away!', it'll go."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 107: The Parable of the Lost Sheep
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Lost Sheep
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "The kingdom can be compared to a shepherd who had a hundred sheep. The largest one strayed. He left the ninety-nine and looked for that one until he found it. Having gone through the trouble, he said to the sheep: 'I love you more than the ninety-nine.'"

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 108: Becoming Like Jesus
gospel_of_thomas.title: Becoming Like Jesus
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever drinks from my mouth will become like me, and I myself will become like them; then, what's hidden will be revealed to them."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 109: The Parable of the Hidden Treasure
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Parable of the Hidden Treasure
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "The kingdom can be compared to someone who had a treasure [hidden] in their field. [They] didn't know about it. After they died, they left it to their son. The son didn't know it either. He took the field and sold it.

"The buyer plowed the field, [found] the treasure, and began to loan money at interest to whomever they wanted."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 110: Riches and Renunciation (2)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Riches and Renunciation (2)
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "Whoever has found the world and become rich should renounce the world."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 111: Those Who are Living Won't Die (2)
gospel_of_thomas.title: Those Who are Living Won't Die (2)
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Jesus said, "The heavens and the earth will roll up in front of you, and whoever lives from the Living One won't see death."

Doesn't Jesus say, "Whoever finds themselves, of them the world isn't worthy"?

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 112: Flesh and Soul
gospel_of_thomas.title: Flesh and Soul
gospel_of_thomas.t: Jesus said, "How awful for the flesh that depends on the soul. How awful for the soul that depends on the flesh."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 113: The Kingdom is Already Present
gospel_of_thomas.title: The Kingdom is Already Present
gospel_of_thomas.t:
His disciples said to him, "When will the kingdom come?"

"It won't come by looking for it. They won't say, 'Look over here!' or 'Look over there!' Rather, the Father's kingdom is already spread out over the earth, and people don't see it."

gospel_of_thomas.r: Gospel of Thomas — Saying 114: Peter and Mary
gospel_of_thomas.title: Peter and Mary
gospel_of_thomas.t:
Simon Peter said to them, "Mary should leave us, because women aren't worthy of life."

Jesus said, "Look, am I to make her a man? So that she may become a living spirit too, she's equal to you men, because every woman who makes herself manly will enter the kingdom of heaven."
